name: Marriage Laws
overview: Scripture establishes marriage as a sacred union ordained by God, where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife as one flesh, a bond not to be broken by man (Genesis 2:24; Mark 10:9). The New Testament underscores the seriousness of divorce, permitting it only on the grounds of fornication, and warns that remarriage after divorce outside this exception constitutes adultery (Matthew 5:32; 19:9; Luke 16:18). Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ’s love for the church (Ephesians 5:25), highlighting the covenantal and self-giving nature of marriage according to biblical teaching.
